abstract: Teratomas commonly occur in the testis and ovary, whereas in the uterus they are rare. The authors report findings for a mass detected in the uterus of a 26-week-old mouse in a colony of C57BL/6 bred in their laboratory. The mass was located in the endometrium and protruded into the lumen. Histopathologically, it consisted of abnormal diploblastic or triploblastic tissues. Bone with a growth plate and myeloid cells, as well as cartilage, was mainly observed. It also included melanocytes, exocrine gland-like cells, striated muscle, and neuron-like cells. While these tissues were accompanied by extensive necrosis, all of them were well differentiated and lacked features of malignancy, such as invasion and metastasis. This mouse had experienced parturition, but fetal tissue was not observed in the lesion. Therefore, the lesion was diagnosed as a benign teratoma, which was spontaneously developed in the uterus.
abstract_ja: 奇形腫は精巣や卵巣によく発生する一方、子宮での発生はまれである。著者らは、自身の研究室で飼育しているC57BL/6系統の26週齢マウスで子宮に見つかった腫瘤を報告する。腫瘤は子宮内膜に位置し、内腔へ突出していた。組織学的には、異常な二胚葉性または三胚葉性の組織から成っていた。成長板を伴う骨と骨髄系細胞、軟骨が主に認められた。また、メラノサイト、外分泌腺様細胞、横紋筋、神経様細胞も含まれていた。これらの組織には広範な壊死を伴っていたが、いずれも高分化であり、浸潤や転移といった悪性の特徴を欠いていた。このマウスは分娩を経験していたが、病変内に胎児組織は認められなかった。したがって、本病変は子宮に自然発生した良性奇形腫と診断された。
